import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier, ExtraTreesClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score
from feat import fe, get_Xy

tr = pd.read_csv('data/train_split.csv')
trf = fe(tr)
X = get_Xy(trf)
yd = (1 - tr.Survived.values)
female_mask = (tr.Sex=='female').values

def evaluate(model, X, yd, fmask):
    cv = StratifiedKFold(10, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
    f1_f, f1_all = [], []
    for tr_idx, va_idx in cv.split(X, yd):
        Xtr, Xva = X.iloc[tr_idx], X.iloc[va_idx]
        ytr, yva = yd[tr_idx], yd[va_idx]
        m = model.fit(Xtr, ytr)
        p = m.predict(Xva)
        # F1 on female validation instances
        vf = fmask[va_idx]
        if vf.sum()>0:
            f1_f.append(f1_score(yva[vf], p[vf]))
        f1_all.append(f1_score(yva, p))
    print(type(model).__name__, 'F1(death) on female-valid:', round(np.mean(f1_f),4), 'all-valid:', round(np.mean(f1_all),4))

for model in [RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced'),
              RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, random_state=42),
              GradientBoostingClassifier(random_state=42),
              ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=500, random_state=42)]:
